page.title: Maryam
page.intro: Explore Maryam, a captivating destination offering unforgettable landscapes, historical heritage, and rich cultural experiences in Morocco.

content.hero_subtitle: Discover the authentic charm and unique experiences of Maryam.
content.sec1_text: Located in one of Morocco's most picturesque regions, Maryam offers visitors an immersive journey into rich heritage, stunning architecture, and warm local hospitality.
content.sec2_text: Whether you are exploring historical sites, tasting traditional Moroccan flavors, or discovering surrounding natural landscapes, Maryam provides memorable moments for every traveler.
content.sec3_text: To make the most of your visit to Maryam, plan your itinerary during optimal seasons, connect with certified local guides, and experience authentic local accommodations.
